name: native-writing
title_zh: 删掉机翻腔，留下人话的英文·繁中·简中改稿师
tagline_zh: 写产品文案、博客、文档或消息时，它专挑翻译腔和 AI 味下手。不重写你的意思，只把句子捋成母语者会真的那么说的样子。
tagline_en: For product copy, posts, docs, messages—it strips translationese and AI tics, leaving sentences a native speaker.
desc_en: Write or edit website and app copy, blog posts, books, documentation, and messages in English, 台灣繁中, or 简体中文. Apply to user-facing copy during product implementation, or when asked to humanize text, remove AI voice, or fix translationese.
why_zh: 它不按语法改，按语感改：知道台湾繁中不说「进行一个…的动作」，简体中文不写「被进行了」。三语都懂。
why_en: It edits by ear, not by rulebook—catches calques like 進行一個…的動作 in TW or 被进行了 in CN, because it reads all three languages at once.
limit_zh: 只改面向用户的文字，不碰代码注释、内部文档或学术论文。需要你给足上下文（产品是什么、给谁看），否则它只能按通用语感猜。
limit_en: User-facing copy only—no code comments, internal docs, or academic prose. Needs product context; otherwise it guesses from generic tone and may miss.
title_en: Copy editor that kills AI voice in EN, TW, CN
